item: a CI run takes two runners fewer: DuckDB 1.x runs inside the columnar job, the urllib3 floor inside the PQC job
summary: measured first: the shard deal was balanced within 1% (a fresh cost table would save about 10 s), the slow leg moved between runs on one deal (a slower runner, every test about 1.4x), and the required aggregators waited 7 to 13 min for a free runner; so the jobs columnar-duckdb1 and urllib3-floor became venvs inside columnar and crypto, each check still its own named step, the required check names unchanged
